_comment: Alpha capacity gate (ALPHA-GATE.md). node loadtest.js gate <report folder> [--host-summary host-summary.json]. A 'gate' criterion must pass at every step up to gateBots; 'stretch' ones are judged at the largest step; 'advisory' ones are reported, never fail the gate. Baseline for the numbers: the 2026-09-20 sweep on the Windows server (CHECKLIST 'headless load-test harness'): 100 bots, no errors, no disconnects, RSS flat at ~1 GB, 20% of one core, event-loop lag p99 24.9 ms.
